title: baseline: ChecklistSend::others_can_mark_tasks_as_done
trigger: Compose a checklist and send
effect: Nothing wrong today: it is a send option, not a stage
fix: Move to scripts/implicit-state-allow.txt with a reason (a send option), or an enum of who may mark tasks

title: LaunchChats keeps one stage as a raw AtomicU8 with u8 consts plus a separate owner AtomicI64 with a NO_OWNER sentinel
trigger: Launch: claim(client) then Ready/answer envelopes move stage; wait() also stores IN by hand after a Skipped or Capped wait
effect: No bug today (launch only); the owner is never cleared and the stage is moved from observe, set_in and wait in three places
fix: One enum Launch { Starting, Claimed{client}, Asked{client}, In } behind one Mutex, transitions in one method

title: TdHub run stage is two AtomicBools plus an Option<JoinHandle>; a replacement hub resets `stopped` by hand
trigger: Receive thread panics 16 times, shared() starts a replacement via Handover which stores stopped=false on the old hub's flag; shutdown/stop_within take the handle
effect: Stage (Running, Stopped unexpectedly, Stopping, Joined) is implied by shutdown, stopped and thread.is_some(); start() clears stopped from outside the hub's own transitions
fix: enum HubStage { Running, Died, Stopping, Joined } owned by the hub; Handover moves clients, not a flag

title: RequestLogGate state is a (count, Option<i32>) tuple whose two parts must change together
trigger: hide() by first call stores the read level in .1; show() by last call takes it; a read that fails leaves .1 None while count is 1
effect: Count and saved level are kept in step by hand; Some/None of the level also means 'read failed' vs 'not hidden'
fix: enum Gate { Shown, Hidden{calls:usize, saved:Option<i32>} }

title: Per-account accent palettes are never dropped when an account is removed or logged out, and the 'active account' is a process-wide global
trigger: Log in, receive updateAccentColors, remove the account; PALETTES keeps its entry for the process lifetime (set_palette is only ever written in apply.rs:256)
effect: Stale palette kept after account removal; a re-added account with the same key paints with the old table until its first update. Harmless in practice
fix: Hold the palette in the account's own state (OnScreen/Session) and read it from there, or clear on Farewell

title: expiration_date and backdrop colors are narrowed with `as i32` from i64 (wraps silently)
trigger: TDLib sends an out-of-range int53 for emoji status expiration_date or backdrop colour
effect: Wrapped value, a wrong or negative expiry; no panic
fix: Use i32::try_from(..).unwrap_or(0) or the sat_i32 helper

title: Story album id narrowed with `as i32` (wraps silently)
trigger: storyAlbum id outside i32
effect: Two albums can collide on id; no panic
fix: i32::try_from(..).ok()? so the album is skipped instead

title: Scheduled send date narrowed with `date as i32` (wraps past 2038) in message_send_options and edit_message_scheduling_state
trigger: A SendAtDate whose i64 unix timestamp exceeds i32::MAX reaches message_send_options (line 196) or edit_message_scheduling_state (line 875); the cast wraps to a negative/past send_date. Not reachable if the schedule picker caps dates (Telegram allows about one year), which was not confirmed.
effect: The message is scheduled for a wrong time or TDLib rejects it, instead of the picked date.
fix: i32::try_from(date) with an error path, or clamp where SendAtDate is built; panic-safety rule 5 (saturate received/user arithmetic)

title: baseline: TopPerson::saved_messages
trigger: Search strip lists Saved Messages tile
effect: Tile for the Saved Messages chat is built (bool fact in the baseline; no bug today)
fix: TopPersonKind { SavedMessages, Chat } or drop it and ask session.is_saved_messages(chat_id)

title: Tray/taskbar visibility is two bools plus a derived WorkMode; (false,false) is representable and fixed up by hand
trigger: Edit appearance_prefs.json to show_tray_icon=false and show_taskbar_icon=false, or toggle switches
effect: Load accepts both off; every reader maps it to WindowOnly by convention (from_switches, toggle_* force the other bit on). Nothing but toggle_* keeps the pair legal
fix: Store WorkMode (WindowAndTray|TrayOnly|WindowOnly) in AppearancePrefs and derive the two switch states

title: Wallet Fetch<()> stages (explorer, state_fetch, rates_fetch) never hold their RequestId; answers and errors are matched by purpose
trigger: Open Money (LoadState sent), server turns can_use_ton_wallet off then on (set_can_use(false) sets state_fetch Idle), open Money again: a second LoadState goes out; the first request's late error calls state_fetch.fail with no request check and fails the second one's Loading
effect: Fetch is Loading{request:None} for the whole flight (Fetch::sent is never called in connect/ton_wallet.rs); apply_ton_wallet_error and the explorer arms (groups/apply.rs, payments/error.rs) act on purpose alone, so an older request's answer or error lands on a newer fetch
fix: Call Fetch::sent(request) after each send and use answered/failed(request, ..) in the reducers

title: MoneyPage::open bool sits beside tab/history/nfts/detail; a closed page must be all-default, reset by hand in three places
trigger: Money page closed or wallet option turned off
effect: open=false is only meaningful when the rest equals MoneyPage::default(); close_money_page, set_can_use(false) and open_money_page each reassign the whole struct by hand, and the dialog predicate reads open separately from the lists
fix: Option<MoneyPage> (or MoneyState::{Closed, Open(MoneyPage)}) on TonWalletState

title: open_money_page returns early on a failed explorer/state/rates send, so history is never requested but the Money box still opens
trigger: LoadState, GetCurrencyExchangeRates or getApplicationConfig send fails (client closing, send error) while opening Money, or opening a transfer card
effect: open_money_page sets money.open=true then `?`-returns before fetch_wallet_history; open_money and open_transfer_details only note the error and still open_box(Money). History stays Idle: no spinner, no error, no Retry, empty page until the user closes and reopens
fix: Send the history page first (or collect the sends' errors) so each fetch is independent; failure of one must not skip the others

title: A failed first page of Money history has no Retry
trigger: History request answers with an error (network, wallet server) on Transactions tab
effect: Paged::Failed{shown:None} draws only the error line; Load more is drawn only when has_more() (needs a shown page) and set_money_tab refetches only Collectibles, so the Transactions list stays failed until the Money box is closed and opened again
fix: Draw a Retry button for Paged::Failed (calls fetch_wallet_history(false)/fetch_wallet_nfts(false))

title: ProfileAddress::None means both 'no wallet' and 'lookup failed', and Loading carries no request, so a failed lookup is never retried
trigger: Open a user's profile while getUserTonWalletAddresses fails; reopen the profile
effect: apply_ton_wallet_error inserts None; fetch_user_ton_wallet_address skips any user already in the map, so the address row never appears until restart or a can_use toggle. A late error after set_can_use(false) (which clears the map) re-inserts None and blocks the lookup when the wallet comes back. Loading/answers are matched by user id and purpose, not by RequestId
fix: ProfileAddress::{Loading{request}, Found, NoWallet, Failed} with Failed re-asked on the next open; drop the entry on can_use=false answers

title: set_can_use(false) drops the Money page but leaves an open wallet notice
trigger: Money page's Send/Receive/Backup notice is open (on_money_page surface), then the can_use_ton_wallet option turns off
effect: notice stays Some(surface) with the Money page gone; also explorer/rates_fetch/ton_usd_rate are not reset, so the off->on cycle is inconsistent with state_fetch which is
fix: Reset the whole wallet state (TonWalletState::default keeping explorer) in set_can_use(false), or clear notice with money

title: ToneUpload::Uploading holds no RequestId: the answer is matched by purpose and nothing ends it if the answer never comes
trigger: Start Upload Sound, connection or TDLib client drops the request without an answer
effect: finish_tone_upload and apply_tone_upload_error act on RequestPurpose::UploadSavedNotificationSound only (Added{target:None} exists for 'not Uploading'); upload_notification_tone refuses while Uploading, so uploads are blocked and the footer spinner stays until the account session is rebuilt. Also a new upload may overwrite an unconsumed Added/Failed outcome
fix: Uploading{request,..}; settle only the matching request; clear to Failed on session reset

title: ExportView Shown/Hidden is a two-variant enum beside the real stage (AccountProgress) and is set by hand from five sites
trigger: Open, Hide, close X, Cancel/Done, dialog .close closure
effect: The box's visibility lives on AccountExport.view and is written by set_account_export_view from open_account_export, on_close, the .close closure and the Hide button; poll_account_export_progress then reads it to decide clearing the settled export
fix: One stage owner for the box: DialogKind visibility derives from ExportBox, with Hidden implied by the box being closed

title: Folder picker answer applies to whatever draft is current, not the one that asked
trigger: Click Change, (non-modal portal) Cancel the box, reopen Export Telegram data, then pick a folder in the first dialog
effect: draft_mut() is the new draft; its folder changes to the old pick. The answer carries no key of the draft that asked
fix: Give each draft a token (or hold the picker task in the draft) and apply only to the draft that asked

title: Tray publisher's stopped flag is set only when its loop ends normally
trigger: The tray update worker panics (caught by spawn_guarded) or cannot be spawned
effect: done.store(true) comes after the loop inside the guarded closure, so a panic or spawn failure leaves stopped=false forever: poll() never restarts the item, and the unread badge/toggles freeze until the watcher closes or Quill restarts
fix: Set stopped from a drop guard in the worker closure, and set it when spawn_guarded fails

title: Tray::set_unread records last_shown before the icon is set, and ignores set_icon failure
trigger: Native set_icon/Icon::from_rgba fails once for a count
effect: last_shown already equals (unread,muted,dark), so the icon is not retried until the count changes; tooltip may then disagree with the icon
fix: Record last_shown only after set_icon returns Ok

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut on TRAY held across native tray calls
trigger: sync_tray runs (Tray::new / set_icon / state.poll) while any code in that call re-enters tray_available()/tray_registering() (they borrow() the same cell)
effect: BorrowError panic on the UI thread; no re-entry path found today, but the guard spans native calls (panic-safety rule 6)
fix: Take the Tray out of the cell for the call, or use try_borrow_mut with early return

title: TranslatePrefs::skip dedups only adjacent entries, so a duplicate language makes toggle_skip a no-op
trigger: translate_prefs.json skip_languages lists the same language twice non-adjacently (or two aliases that normalize to one code, e.g. zh and zh-CN)
effect: toggle_skip removes only the first match; the second stays, so the language cannot be removed from Do Not Translate
fix: Dedup with a seen-set in skip() and normalize on load

title: AgeCheck { NotStarted, Started } is the old age_verify_started bool; nothing clears it but the screen drop
trigger: Tap Verify my age (sets Started), finish or abandon the verification, later the server asks for age verification again, then turn on Show 18+ Content
effect: age_gate_blocks sees Started and skips the prompt although the server asks again; the flag lives for the whole screen. Section 8 07-021 skip says already OpenNotice + AgeCheck, which is the same flag as a two-variant enum
fix: Derive from the session's age_verification (the verification the bot was opened for, carried in the notice or session) or an AgeCheck::Started{asked_for: params id} that is dropped when session.sync.age_verification changes

title: submit_delete_account clears the inputs, resets the stage and drops the send error
trigger: Open Account box, type the 2FA password and a reason, arm Delete, press Alright delete while chats_path_active() is false or a TTL write is pending (delete_account returns Err(InvalidRequest))
effect: The password and reason are wiped, the confirm banner collapses to Open and no note is shown; the user believes the deletion started or has to retype everything
fix: Match the Result of driver.delete_account: only on Ok clear inputs and leave ConfirmDelete (AccountOp::Mutating(id) shows the progress); on Err keep ConfirmDelete and set an error note

title: submit_account_ttl and submit_default_auto_delete drop the driver's Err
trigger: Pick a self-destruct period or auto-delete preset while the chats path is not active or another account mutation is pending
effect: The radio snaps back (value is authoritative) with no note and no retry hint
fix: On Err set StatusNote::error (as submit_logout does) or disable the radios while not sendable

title: AccountsUiState keeps open, row_edit and error as three fields reset by hand at six sites
trigger: open_accounts, close_accounts, start_account_rename, save_account_name, the Rename cancel, the Remove arm and cancel buttons each clear a different subset of row_edit and error
effect: No bug today (open_accounts and close_accounts reset both), but a new site that forgets error shows a stale line over the next row action
fix: enum AccountsDialog { Closed, Open { row_edit: AccountRowEdit, error: Option<String> } } replaced whole on open and close; the DialogSpec predicate reads Open

title: wake_at is a 0-sentinel slot naming a timer whose Task is detach()ed
trigger: While the takeover phase changes with nothing animating, wake_takeover_at schedules a one-shot timer; takeover.wake_at (0 = none) records its time and the detached task resets it
effect: No stuck state today (a later render reschedules), but the stage and its timer are two things: the timer cannot be cancelled and a replaced earlier wake still fires and notifies
fix: enum Wake { None, At { at: u64, _task: Task<()> } } held in TakeoverUi; replacing it drops the older timer

title: Driver::Running { id, waiting } names an input command's task, which is detach()ed; the exit runs only if the window update succeeds
trigger: An agent sends an input command (ui_click) and a second one that queues in waiting; the main window is closed or its update_in fails before the first command's task reaches agent_command_finished
effect: Driver stays Running for the process: every later input command is pushed into waiting and never started or answered, so the agent's tool times out until Quill restarts
fix: Hold the command's Task inside Driver::Running so dropping the owner ends it, and have agent_command_finished (or a Drop guard) leave the stage and answer the waiting Pendings with window_closed

title: The consent and reset-token boxes are hidden with && enabled() instead of being closed when Agent access goes off
trigger: Open Reset token (reset_confirm) or the All other chats consent, turn Agent access off from another window or Revoke, then turn it on again
effect: The box reappears with the old scope or token-reset question on the next render, and Allow would widen grants the user asked for before the switch changed
fix: Clear both in set_agent_access / Revoke (one place), or make the box state part of the access-on stage; section 8 12-112 only covers that reset_confirm is the registry predicate, not this extra condition

title: The recent-actions chat is held three times: EventLogSearch::shows, EventLogPage::chat and GroupSettingsDialog::chat_id, reconciled by frame upkeep
trigger: Open Recent actions for chat A, go to chat B's log by any route (info panel, Group Settings of another window)
effect: No bug today: event_log_search_upkeep refills the box when shows != open chat and event_log_page_for replaces the page; but the box text is wrong for one frame and the refill is a per-frame reset from outside the transition
fix: One EventLogView { chat, search_input_text_for: chat, page } owned by the Recent actions page of GroupSettingsDialog, replaced whole when the chat changes

title: autoload mark is set before load_more_event_log sends; a failed send leaves the mark and the Loading older spinner
trigger: In Recent actions with has_more at the top of a short list, fetch_chat_event_log_more returns Err (connection down)
effect: A note flashes, the list shows Loading older forever and the mark equals the list length, so render never asks again; only a scroll event or reopening the page retries
fix: Set the mark only when the send returned Ok, or EventLogMore { Idle, Asked { len, request } } cleared by the error arm; show Retry on failure

title: event_log_ids RefCell borrow_mut is held across ListState reset/splice/remeasure calls
trigger: Recent actions list rebuilt while a scroll-handler defer or measure re-enters the app (event_log_list_view line 483, event_log_reset_list line 462)
effect: A re-entrant borrow would panic and end the process; today nothing re-enters event_log_ids, so no crash is known
fix: Take the ids out of the cell (std::mem::take), plan the sync, call the list, write the new ids back; or keep ids as plain field behind &mut self

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the dialog content closure (one-shot body cell)
trigger: The kit calls the content closure again while it runs (re-entrancy), which no known path does
effect: Would panic on a nested borrow; today the guard is a temporary dropped in the same statement
fix: try_borrow_mut with an empty div fallback, or hand the element over without a RefCell

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the Accounts dialog content closure (one-shot body cell)
trigger: Same as 07-5-011: re-entrant call of the content closure
effect: Would panic on a nested borrow; none known
fix: try_borrow_mut with an empty div fallback

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in dialog_with's content closure (shared by the request, consent and reset boxes)
trigger: Same as 07-5-011: re-entrant call of the content closure
effect: Would panic on a nested borrow; none known
fix: try_borrow_mut with an empty div fallback

title: BLOCKED thread-local RefCell borrow_mut (block_opened_by_agent, take_blocked_closing_layers) and the queue is not owner-scoped
trigger: An agent step opens a hard dialog in one window; the queue names it by dialog or layer name only, and the shell of another window or account takes it before the owner's frame
effect: A borrow in a re-entrant drain would panic; and a queued name can close a same-named box of another window or the next account after a switch
fix: Key entries by (ScreenEpoch, window) and use try_borrow_mut, or return the Vec from the step instead of a global

title: AiComposeOpen::view and ::editor must change together (editor is Some exactly in the StyleEditor and StyleIcon views)
trigger: Reset by hand in ai_compose_dismissed, remove_ai_style, ai_style_edit_upkeep and open_ai_style_editor; set_ai_compose_view(StyleEditor) is callable with editor None
effect: None today; a missed reset shows an empty editor view (ai_style_editor_view returns an empty div)
fix: AiComposeView::StyleEditor(StyleEditor) / StyleIcon(StyleEditor) carrying the editor, so leaving the view drops it

title: AiComposeUi::button_shown_at is a derived 'button was wanted last frame' flag kept in step by sync_ai_compose_button
trigger: Main window upkeep only (locked or hidden main window skips it); a chat window's button never blinks and reads BLINK; value follows the main window's composer while the button draws in any window
effect: Blink skipped or wrong window; no data loss
fix: Derive the blink start from the composer's own visibility transition per window (WindowSlot), or an enum ButtonFade{Hidden,Shown{at}} owned by the window that draws it

title: Closing the AI box leaves the language search text; it reappears when the box is reopened
trigger: Open box, Translate tab, tap the language, type a query, Cancel and close the box, open it again and open the language picker
effect: The picker opens filtered by the old query
fix: Clear language_search in close_ai_compose / open_ai_compose (or hold the query in AiComposeView::Languages)

title: ai_compose_dispatch returns without failing the box when there is no live connection, so the box stays Loading
trigger: Open the box (or change tab) while self.live is None (demo session, connection being replaced)
effect: Skeleton and spinner stay until the box is closed; the request token is never answered nor failed
fix: Treat live None like a send error: ai.fail(token, ..) and toast

title: open_ai_style_preview treats 'no live connection' as sent, so the preview stays LookingUp forever
trigger: Open an addstyle link while self.live is None
effect: Loading skeleton with no request out; only closing the box ends it
fix: is_none_or should be a send failure unless demo_session is the owner

title: remove_ai_style closes the editor and returns to the card when nothing was sent (no live)
trigger: Edit Style, Delete Style, confirm, while live is None
effect: Editor closes with no toast, the style is not deleted
fix: Only close the editor on Some(Ok(request)); toast on None

title: PreviewStage::LookingUp { token: 0 } is a placeholder stage written by mem::replace at three sites
trigger: show_again, add_ai_style_from_preview and remove_ai_style swap in a fake LookingUp stage before matching the old one back; an early return between would leave a lookup with token 0 that nothing answers
effect: None today; a transition written as take-and-put-back
fix: A by-value transition method on PreviewStage (fn into_adding(self, request) -> Self) so no placeholder is needed

title: Layer::prepaint and Layer::paint hold items.borrow() across layout, prepaint, paint and the build closures
trigger: A tile or mirror element built by the layer that registers or paints layered content in the same Layer (Layered::prepaint/paint borrow items; register uses borrow_mut) would hit a BorrowMutError panic; panic-safety rule 6
effect: Process abort on a re-entrant registration
fix: Clone the Rc'd content out of the borrow (or index with short borrows) before calling into GPUI

title: Slice frame stage is LayerState::painted (Cell<bool>) plus per-item seq==0 sentinel, inline and opacity Cells, reset by begin_frame/end_frame
trigger: begin_frame clears items and painted; plan() reads painted to decide replay vs fresh; items registered by a discarded prepaint keep seq 0
effect: None today; a frame is Prepainting / Painted(items) held as three loose pieces
fix: enum Frame { Prepainting(items), Painted(items) } with Item { painted: Option<Painted{seq,opacity,inline}> }

title: Non-test RefCell borrow/borrow_mut on frame.media_roots_frame (also taken in app_render/mod.rs:108)
trigger: media_display_roots reads borrow(), computes, then borrow_mut(); render does borrow_mut().take(); a re-entrant call from compute_media_display_roots while a guard lives would panic
effect: Process abort if the guards ever overlap (they are short today)
fix: Cell<Option<Rc<[PathBuf]>>> with take/set, no guard

title: TakeoverUi::wake_at names a pending timer (0 = none) while the task is a detached spawn_app in agent_takeover.rs
trigger: wake_takeover_at sets wake_at then spawns a detached timer; an earlier timer still fires after being superseded and clears nothing; it runs while locked or hidden
effect: One spare notify per superseded timer; no way to cancel on owner going away
fix: Option<(u64, Task)> held in the stage; dropping it cancels the wake

title: Story cover and privacy answers settle by request but act on the panel and story open now, not the ones that sent
trigger: Save a story cover (or privacy), open the Cover picker on another story or reopen it before the answer; Saved closes whichever Cover panel is open; Failed reports against open_cover_story()
effect: A fresh picker closes under the user, or the failure names the wrong story
fix: Hold the story key with the request (cover_request: Option<(RequestId, StoryKey)>) and close or report only when the panel is for that key

title: Main render runs file-fetching steps before the lock check, so a Premium preview left open keeps downloading while locked
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview, lock the app; sync_premium_preview_files (and inline_videos_frame_start, check_video_pip, sync_video_avatar, sync_userpic_videos) still run each frame before is_locked() returns locked_root
effect: Downloads and video work while locked; contradicts 'what runs while locked' (only notifications)
fix: Move the steps under a lock_waits() guard or after the locked early return

title: Toast wake-up is a detached spawn_screen task named by ToastQueue::wake; skipped after an account switch, so the toast outlives its deadline until something else redraws
trigger: Account A posts a toast (wake armed for deadline D, task detached). Switch to account B before D. At D the task's update is not run (spawn_screen: no updates once another account is on screen), so no notify happens; ToastQueue (app part of ConnectionUi) is shown on B and nothing redraws an idle B.
effect: The toast stays on screen past its time until the next unrelated redraw; ToastQueue::wake keeps naming a timer that never delivered
fix: hold the timer Task inside the queue's stage (Armed { deadline, task }) and spawn it as an app task (spawn_app), so it notifies whichever account is on screen and is dropped with the queue

title: AiAsk::Asked is matched by composer markup, and the AI answer slots carry no RequestId; the send's RequestId is dropped
trigger: Press Fix, then Rewrite on the same draft before the first answer lands (send_ai_compose does not refuse while AiAsk::Asked). Both asks store Asked{markup} and both answers match it.
effect: The first answer is applied as if it were the second ask's; the second answer then finds AiAsk::Idle and shows 'the draft changed, AI answer ignored' although nothing was typed. If both answers arrive within one frame the single Option slot (ai_composer_text / ai_composer_blocks) is overwritten and one is lost. A failed ask leaves Asked set for good, so a late answer for an old ask applies whenever the field holds the same markup again.
fix: AiAsk::Asked { request: RequestId, markup } (as SentText::Sent does), the answer carries its RequestId and applies only when it equals the held one; an error answer returns the stage to Idle

title: The custom accent picker is built once from accent_rgb and never follows the applied theme or accent
trigger: On Day pick a custom accent in the Custom select, then click the Night tile (or click a preset accent circle). appearance_accent_section draws the new theme's selected swatch, but ColorSelect still shows the old picker value (accent_picker has no writer after construction).
effect: Two values for one accent: the swatch row says one colour, the Custom field shows another theme's colour (or the stale old single accent_rgb)
fix: derive the picker value from theme_accent(applied theme) whenever the applied theme or accent changes (set_value in set_theme_accent / apply_appearance), or build it per applied theme

title: Wallpaper delete confirm holds a bare background id, is never re-checked with removable(), and has no closer
trigger: Click the x on wallpaper W (inline confirm opens), then open W's preview and Apply it (W is now in use) or leave Appearance and come back; the confirm is still there and Delete removes W. Leaving Settings does not clear DialogsUi::wallpaper_remove.
effect: The in-use wallpaper (or one the list no longer has) can be removed; a context-free 'Delete this wallpaper?' reappears when Appearance is reopened
fix: confirm stage owned by the Appearance page (cleared when the page closes) and validated against removable(background, in_use) at confirm time

title: conversation_rendered and conversation_shown are two Cell<bool> kept in step by hand (render sets, history_drawn takes both)
trigger: render_slice sets conversation_rendered, conversation_column sets conversation_shown, history_drawn() replaces both with false; readers (notify_tick, notify_conversations) read conversation_shown() between frames
effect: No bug today; the three real stages (absent / replayed from cache / rendered) are encoded in two flags whose combination and reset order matter, and a tick read between the reset and the next layout sees 'not shown'
fix: one Cell<ConversationFrame> enum { Absent, Replayed, Rendered }

title: 'Make Quill the default' re-reads the handler through three detached 1/3/8 s timers that no stage owns
trigger: Click the button (macOS/Windows button form); three cx.spawn timers are detached, each calling link_handler::read_now() and notify. Clicking again stacks three more; they also fire after Settings is closed or the app is locked.
effect: Wasted reads and redraws; the 'waiting for the system confirmation' stage exists only as timers
fix: a LinkHandlerCheck { Idle, Rechecking { task } } stage in PreferencesUi that owns one task which polls at 1/3/8 s and is dropped on a new click or when the page goes

title: Capture is reset to Idle by hand at five call sites instead of one transition
trigger: Cancel button (113), Reset (139), Escape (221), a refused chord (234) and a saved chord (253) each write Capture::Idle directly; only start_capture and KeybindingUi::end are methods
effect: No bug today; each site decides separately whether the row's refusal message goes too (Reset clears it, Cancel and Escape keep it), so the next site can miss one
fix: KeybindingUi::cancel() / finish() that move Waiting to Idle and own the refusal bookkeeping

title: The Omarchy watcher polls every 2 s for the life of the process once a theme is found, even when not following Omarchy, hidden or locked
trigger: Run on Omarchy with follow_omarchy off (or minimise to tray / lock); the Watching stage keeps the loop: timer, background stat, and on a change OmarchyState::read + apply_appearance + notify
effect: A background thread hop every 2 s and a redraw on every Omarchy theme switch while the user does not use the theme
fix: enter Watching only while appearance.follow_omarchy (or the chooser is open) and leave to Found otherwise, dropping the task

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut of frame.surfaces.toasts in the render path
trigger: status_toast_in runs per window frame; any future call from inside the borrow (follow/moving are pure today) or a re-entrant frame would panic. chat_window close uses try_borrow_mut for the same cell, so the two paths already assume overlap.
effect: Panic on the UI thread if the borrow ever overlaps
fix: try_borrow_mut with an early return (panic-safety rule 6) or a plain per-window slot owned by the WindowSlot

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut inside the theme editor dialog content closure, used as a one-shot take slot
trigger: The scrollable dialog content closure runs at render; a second call of the same closure gets the fallback empty div instead of the body
effect: Today the dialog is rebuilt every frame so each closure runs once; if the kit calls it again (resize, re-layout) the editor body disappears. A nested borrow would panic.
fix: build the body inside the closure (it only reads QuillApp state captured by value) or use try_borrow_mut

title: The Appearance page asks for the installed wallpapers from render, and a failed send returns the Fetch to Idle so the next frame asks again
trigger: Open Appearance while the connection cannot send (fetch_installed_backgrounds: InvalidRequest, or send_json fails and calls cancel()). ensure_wallpapers_loaded runs in every render of the page and the result is dropped with let _.
effect: A request attempt per render for as long as the page is open and the send keeps failing; no Failed stage records that the send did not leave
fix: Fetch::fail on a send error (shown with the page's Retry button), asked once per page open from the open transition instead of from render
